title: Audio Transformers (Whisper)
motto: Audio is an image of frequency over time. Whisper is a ViT that eats mel spectrograms and speaks back.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Audio is an image of frequency over time. Whisper is a ViT that eats mel spectrograms and speaks back.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: Before Whisper (OpenAI, Radford et al. 2022), state-of-the-art automatic speech recognition (ASR) meant wav2vec 2.0 and HuBERT — self-supervised feature extractors plus a fine-tuned head. High quality, expensive data pipelines, domain-brittle. Multilingual speech recognition needed separate models per language family.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: Log-mel spectrograms become a sequence. Whisper encoder-decoder transcribes speech to text.

steps.title: Implement whisper
steps.body: Write the function from scratch in the workspace. Run when ready — all tests must pass.
